{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin + browser extension bridge: browser_* agent tools (navigate, click, type, screenshot, eval) over a localhost WebSocket — like Kimi WebBridge / Claude's browser extension.","id":"gh:1333451038","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-browser-bridge","slug":"egnmosk/dsh-browser-bridge","topics":["browser-extension","chrome-extension","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","webbridge"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin + browser extension bridge: browser_* agent tools (navigate, click, type, sc"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"reenshot, eval) over a localhost WebSocket — like Kimi WebBridge / Claude's browser extension."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-browser-bridge"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A **DeepSeek Harness plugin + browser extension** pair that lets DSH agents read
and control your br"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"owser - the equivalent of Kimi's WebBridge extension or
Claude's browser extension, but for your own"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ivalent of Kimi's WebBridge extension or
Claude's browser extension, but for your own local harness."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The DSH side exposes 13 model-facing tools; the extension side executes them in
the browser (tabs, D"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"OM, clicks, typing, scrolling, screenshots, eval)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Agent tools"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Tool | What it does |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| `browser_status` | Is the extension connected? Bridge URL, pending commands. |
| `browser_list_tab"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"s` | List open tabs (id, title, url, active). |
| `browser_activate_tab` | Bring a tab to the foregr"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ound. |
| `browser_navigate` | Open a URL, or reload / back / forward; optional new tab. |
| `browse"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"r_snapshot` | Interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs...) with stable CSS selectors. |
| `brows"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"er_read_page` | Visible page text (or a subtree), capped in characters. |
| `browser_click` | Click "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"an element by CSS selector. |
| `browser_type` | Fill an input / textarea / contenteditable (native "},{"id":"p8s7","text":"events). |
| `browser_press` | Send a key (Enter, Tab, Escape, arrows...). |
| `browser_scroll` | Sc"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"roll the page or a scrollable element. |
| `browser_wait` | Wait for a selector to appear/disappear,"},{"id":"p8s9","text":" or just let the page settle. |
| `browser_screenshot` | Save a PNG/JPEG of the current tab to disk "},{"id":"p8s10","text":"(`~/.dsh/browser-bridge/`). |
| `browser_eval` | Evaluate a JS expression in the page (content-scrip"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"owser-bridge/`). |
| `browser_eval` | Evaluate a JS expression in the page (content-script world). |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"When the extension is not connected, every tool fails with a clear message
telling the model (and th"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"e user) how to connect it."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Layout"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"1. The package lives in the web profile's node_modules
(`~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/dsh-browser-br"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"idge`).
2. Registered in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` as row
`browser-bridge` (`name: dsh-"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"browser-bridge`).
3. Recorded in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` dependencies."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Verify the composition at any time:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Activate"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The plugin is loaded at boot, so restart `dsh web` once after installing
(restarting drops the GUI f"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"or a few seconds; it comes back on the same URL).
After the restart, the server
prints `[browser-bri"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"dge] bridge ready - point the DSH Browser Bridge extension
at ws://127.0.0.1:3080/bridge`, and `http"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"://127.0.0.1:3080/bridge/info`
answers JSON. Verify with:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Load the extension"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"1. Open your browser: Chrome, Edge, or Yandex (all Chromium).
2. Go to `chrome://extensions` (Edge: "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"`edge://extensions`, Yandex:
`browser://extensions`).
3. Enable **Developer mode** (top-right toggle"},{"id":"p20s3","text":").
4. Click **Load unpacked** and select the `extension` folder of this package.
5. Click the extens"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ion icon - the popup should show **Connected to DeepSeek
Harness**."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The default server URL is `ws://127.0.0.1:3080/bridge`, which matches `dsh web`
running on its defau"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"lt port. If your harness listens on another port, open the
extension's **Options** page, set the URL"},{"id":"p21s3","text":", and use **Test connection**."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Then just ask an agent, for example:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"> Use the browser to open example.com, read the page, and click the first link."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Configuration (cordis.patch.yml)"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| `path` | `/bridge` | WebSocket endpoint path on the web server. |
| `commandTimeoutMs` | `60000` |"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" How long a tool waits for the extension to answer. |
| `screenshotDir` | `~/.dsh/browser-bridge` | "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"Where screenshots are saved. |
| `maxMessageBytes` | `8 MiB` | Max WS message size (screenshots trav"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ots are saved. |
| `maxMessageBytes` | `8 MiB` | Max WS message size (screenshots travel over WS). |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- `node test/run-test.mjs` - boots a real server + fake extension client and
exercises every tool, t"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"imeouts, disconnect, and the `/bridge/info` route
(40 assertions, no harness boot required).
- Proto"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"col: JSON text frames. Server -> client `request`/`ping`/`welcome`;
client -> server `hello`/`respon"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"se`/`pong`. Commands are camelCase in the
extension protocol (`listTabs`, `snapshot`, `click`, ...) "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"and snake_case in the
model-facing tools."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Security notes"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- The bridge binds only to the web server's loopback host (`127.0.0.1` by
default) and has no authen"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"tication: any local process could connect to
`/bridge` and drive the browser. Treat it like shell ac"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"cess.
- `browser_eval` executes JavaScript in pages - powerful by design; only grant
it to trusted a"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"gents.
- The extension has `<all_urls>` host permissions (required to read tab URLs
and act in any p"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"age). It talks **only** to the configured localhost URL."}],"truncated":false}
